description: FinOps hub dashboard for AI Foundry. Visualization for monitoring Azure AI Foundry usage and latency across model deployments in a single Grafana dashboard.

options.content:
# FinOps hub | AI Foundry

Operational data for FinOps analysis. [Learn about FinOps hubs](https://aka.ms/finops/hubs).

panels.description: Estimated cost calculated from input and output token usage with model-specific pricing. Only models with a configured price appear as tiles. Audio models (tts/transcribe) are text-token lower bounds - audio usage is not token-metered. model-router is intentionally unpriced - its cost depends on the routed model. mai-thinking-1 is unpriced - Microsoft has not published per-token rates while it is in private preview. Use the Price Scale variable to scale all tiles.
panels.title: Estimated Cost

panels.description: Number of prompt tokens processed (input) on a model. Applies to PTU, PTU-Managed and Pay-as-you-go deployments.
panels.title: Input Tokens (total)

panels.description: Number of tokens generated (output) by model deployments in this AI Foundry resource. Applies to PTU, PTU-Managed and Pay-as-you-go deployments.
panels.title: Output Tokens (total)

panels.description: Number of model inference requests to deployments in this AI Foundry resource over a period of time. Applies to PTU, PTU-Managed and Pay-as-you-go deployments.
panels.title: Model Requests

panels.description: Percentage of prompt tokens that matched the prompt cache - higher is better (lower latency and cost for repeated prompts). NOTE: this AzureOpenAI-prefixed metric only reports Azure OpenAI model deployments; non-OpenAI models (Claude, DeepSeek, Kimi, Grok, ...) are not included even when they support caching.
panels.title: Token Cache Match Rate (OpenAI models)

panels.description: Average time to receive the last byte of a model response. Query A uses the model-agnostic TimeToLastByte metric (covers non-OpenAI deployments when they emit it); query B adds AzureOpenAITTLTInMS, which is what Azure OpenAI model traffic actually feeds on Foundry resources. Applies to PTU, PTU-managed, and Pay-as-you-go deployments.
panels.title: Average Latency (Time to Last Byte)

panels.description: Number of inference tokens processed on a model. Calculated as prompt tokens (input) plus generated tokens (output). Applies to PTU, PTU-Managed and Pay-as-you-go deployments.
panels.title: Total Tokens

panels.description: Number of prompt tokens processed (input) on a model. Applies to PTU, PTU-Managed and Pay-as-you-go deployments.
panels.title: Input Tokens

panels.description: Number of tokens generated (output) by model deployments in this AI Foundry resource. Applies to PTU, PTU-Managed and Pay-as-you-go deployments.
panels.title: Output Tokens

panels.description: Model requests that did not return HTTP 200, split by status code: 429 = throttling/quota exhaustion, 5xx = server errors, 499 = client disconnects. Empty when everything succeeds.
panels.title: Non-200 Model Requests (Throttling & Errors)

panels.description: Average generation throughput (tokens/second) per deployment. NOTE: AzureOpenAI-prefixed metric - only Azure OpenAI model deployments report it; the model-agnostic TokensPerSecond metric currently emits no data on Foundry resources.
panels.title: Tokens per Second (OpenAI models)

azureResourceGraph.query:
resources
| where type =~ "microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts" and resourceGroup =~ '$rg'
| project name

list.description: A multiplier applied to the estimated price to scale the final result. This can be used to apply a uniform adjustment such as a discount. For example, a value of 0.8 applies a 20% discount to the estimated price.
list.label: Price Scale
list.name: priceScale
